headline: Waymo has introduced a silver version of its Ojai robotaxi with a refreshed interior and has started road tests.
score_reason: Comfort and appearance update; the China-built claim in the headline is unverified, so lowered by 1.
importance_line: Riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles and Las Vegas will soon see the new cabin, but this is a comfort update, not a change in driving ability, and Waymo is the only source.
summary: Waymo said in a company post on 6 Oct 2026 that the new silver Ojai has soft leatherette seats, carpeted floors, a wireless phone charger and new rear armrests, and is built at its Mesa, Arizona plant. It is now being road-tested and in the coming weeks will start carrying riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles and Las Vegas.
notes: Company announcement read directly; Electric Vehicles carried the story with a China-built angle we could not verify.
